maya: Heads-up — ended up sketching a small fab banner for the regression gating step. want quick UX eyes before i push to figma :eyes: devon: dropping in — can you paste the flow? is this for the scorecard approval modal or the regression list page? maya: regression list page. idea: a persistent banner at top of list when a run has failing tests that blocks "bulk approve" until at least one action is taken (ack/fix/skip). keeps accidental approvals low. sam: love the intent. quick question: how intrusive is the banner? i worry about power users who do bulk workflows. maya: non-modal. compact 48px banner with 2 CTAs: "Review failures" (primary) and "Acknowledge and continue" (secondary). also keyboard shortcut hint: "Press D to open failures". devon: copy nits: "Acknowledge and continue" reads passive. suggest "Acknowledge failures" / then show a secondary confirm toast that allows skipping. also contrast check — bg #fff4e5 on orange text might not meet AA. aria: accessibility: important we trap focus to the failure list when a user hits "Review failures" and that the banner is announced by screenreaders. recommend: role="status" aria-live="polite" with a short message like "Regression tests found: 3 failing". maya: good call. i'll add aria-live. also thinking about adding an inline summary: e.g. "3 failing · 2 flaky · 1 blocked" so folks know severity. sam: can we show a tiny expandable preview (hover/click) so people don't have to jump pages? expands inline rows, just titles + tag icons. keeps flow fast for triage. devon: expand previews are fine but watch visual density. compactness wins. maybe animate height so layout shift is less jarring. aria: keyboard only: ensure Expand/Collapse is operable with Enter/Space and focus goes into first failure row. each row should have an accessible name: "Test: prompt set — missing expected output — open details". maya: mockup will include that. also question for PMs: should "Acknowledge and continue" create an audit event? ie. if someone ignores failures and suits approve, we want traceability. sam: yes — must log who acknowledged and timestamp. also surface it in the rollout audit panel. evals-bot: [auto] regression-run-202-checked — 3 failing / 12 passing / 1 flaky. link: https://console.redwood/regs/202 devon: microcopy suggestion for the banner header: instead of "Regression tests found" try "Unresolved regression failures" — stronger call to action. but check tone with legal/ops. maya: alternate idea: replace hard block with soft-block for teams with "fast lane" permission (like infra/product owners). banner shows "you can acknowledge or require review" for admins. helps power users. aria: permission nuance ok but ensure aria label indicates "soft-block: action recommended" so SR users know it's not a hard modal. sam: rollout plan: ship banner hidden behind feature flag. enable-to-50% orgs first; gather metrics: bulk-approve rate, time-to-approve, accidental-approvals. devon: final visual ask: CTA order should be "Review failures" then "Acknowledge". primary = review. also include a tiny tooltip on the keyboard hint: "D = open failures" for discoverability. maya: will update figma + add spec notes: contrast tokens, aria-live, keyboard interactions, analytics event names (reg_banner_ack, reg_banner_open). ping me if you need copy changes. sam: thanks — schedule 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to sign off before feature flag PR. aria: quick code example for aria-live from my notes: ```
Regression check: 3 failing, 1 flaky
``` devon: tiny tweak: screenreader wants short messages, avoid long lists in aria-live. say "3 failing, details available". maya: final: i'll push updated figma + a small a11y checklist in the ticket. thanks all :heart:
